```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(nflfastR)
library(nflreadr)
library(gt)
library(purrr)
```


```{r}
best_coaches <- read.csv("../../data/processed/total_coach_scores.csv")
best_seasons <- read.csv("../../data/processed/best_season_scores.csv")
scores <- read.csv("../../data/processed/season_scores.csv")
coaches <- read.csv("../../data/raw/coaches.csv")
```

```{r}
teams <- nflreadr::load_teams() %>% 
  select(team = team_abbr, team_logo_espn, team_color) %>% 
  mutate(team = case_when(
    team == "OAK" ~ "LV",
    team == "SD" ~ "LAC", 
    team == "STL" ~ "LA",
    team == "WAS" ~ "WSH",
    .default = team
  )) %>% 
  mutate(team = ifelse(team == "LA", "LAR", team))

coach_latest_team <- scores %>% 
  filter(season > 2016, season < 2026) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(coach, offense, defense),
    names_to = "role",
    values_to = "coach_name"
  ) %>% 
  separate_rows(coach_name, sep = ",") %>% 
  mutate(coach_name = str_trim(coach_name)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(coach_name), coach_name != "") %>% 
  group_by(coach_name) %>% 
  slice_max(season, with_ties = FALSE) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(coach_name, team)

table_data <- best_coaches %>% 
  left_join(coach_latest_team, by = "coach_name") %>% 
  rename(latest_team = team) %>% 
  left_join(teams, by = c("latest_team" = "team"))

logos_df <- scores %>% 
  filter(season > 2016, season < 2026) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(coach, offense, defense),
    names_to = "role",
    values_to = "coach_name"
  ) %>% 
  separate_rows(coach_name, sep = ",") %>% 
  mutate(coach_name = str_trim(coach_name)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(coach_name), coach_name != "") %>% 
  distinct(coach_name, team) %>% 
  left_join(teams, by = c("team")) %>% 
  group_by(coach_name) %>% 
  summarise(
    logos = paste0(team_logo_espn, collapse = " "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

final_table <- table_data %>% 
  left_join(logos_df, by = "coach_name") %>% 
  arrange(desc(total_score)) %>% 
  select(rank, coach_name, seasons, total_score, logos, team_color)
```


```{r}
# Keep only top 10
final_table_top10 <- final_table %>%
  arrange(desc(total_score)) %>% 
  slice_head(n = 10)

# Build GT table
gt_tbl <- final_table_top10 %>% 
  gt() %>% 
  
  # Render logos
  text_transform(
    locations = cells_body(columns = logos),
    fn = function(x) {
      map(x, ~ {
        urls <- strsplit(.x, " ")[[1]]
        paste0(
          web_image(url = urls, height = 25),
          collapse = " "
        )
      })
    }
  ) %>% 
  
  cols_label(
    coach_name = "Coach",
    seasons = "Seasons",
    total_score = "Score",
    logos = "Teams"
  )

# Apply row-wise coloring
for (i in seq_len(nrow(final_table_top10))) {
  gt_tbl <- gt_tbl %>% 
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(color = final_table_top10$team_color[i]),
      locations = cells_body(
        rows = i,
        columns = c(coach_name, total_score)
      )
    )
}

# Final polish
gt_tbl <- gt_tbl %>% 
  cols_align(align = "center", logos) %>% 
  fmt_number(columns = total_score, decimals = 2) %>% 
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = coach_name)
  ) %>% 
  cols_hide(columns = c(team_color, rank))

gt_tbl

gtsave(gt_tbl, "../../output/tables/top10_coaches_since2017.png")
```

```{r}
best_seasons_tbl <- scores %>% 
  filter(season > 2016) %>% 
  group_by(season, team, coach, offense, defense) %>% 
  summarise(score = mean(score), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(desc(score)) %>% 
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>% 
  
  # Join team logos/colors
  left_join(teams, by = c("team")) %>% 
  
  # Keep only what we want
  select(
    rank,
    logos = team_logo_espn,
    team,
    season,
    score,
    coach,
    offense,
    defense,
    team_color
  ) %>% 
  
  # Optional: top 10
  slice_head(n = 10)

best_seasons_tbl <- best_seasons_tbl %>%
  mutate(team_color = ifelse(is.na(team_color), "black", team_color))

# -------------------------------
# Build GT table
# -------------------------------
gt_tbl <- best_seasons_tbl %>% 
  gt() %>% 
  
  # Render logos
  text_transform(
    locations = cells_body(columns = logos),
    fn = function(x) {
      map(x, ~ web_image(url = .x, height = 30))
    }
  ) %>% 
  
  cols_label(
    logos = "",
    team = "Team",
    season = "Season",
    score = "Score",
    coach = "Head Coach",
    offense = "OC",
    defense = "DC"
  )

# -------------------------------
# Row-wise coloring (team color)
# -------------------------------
for (i in seq_len(nrow(best_seasons_tbl))) {
  gt_tbl <- gt_tbl %>% 
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(color = best_seasons_tbl$team_color[i]),
      locations = cells_body(
        rows = i,
        columns = c(team, score, coach, offense, defense, score)
      )
    )
}

# -------------------------------
# Final polish
# -------------------------------
gt_tbl <- gt_tbl %>% 
  cols_align(align = "center", logos) %>% 
  fmt_number(columns = score, decimals = 2) %>% 
  cols_hide(columns = c(team_color)) %>% 
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = coach)
  )

gt_tbl
gtsave(gt_tbl, "../../output/tables/top10_seasons_since2017.png")

```

```{r}
best_seasons_tbl <- scores %>% 
  filter(season == 2025) %>% 
  group_by(season, team, coach, offense, defense) %>% 
  summarise(score = mean(score), .groups = "drop") %>% 
```

```{r}
  group_by(team) %>% 
  slice_head(n = 1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(desc(score)) %>% 
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>% 
  
  left_join(teams, by = "team") %>% 
  
  # Keep only what we want
  select(
    rank,
    logos = team_logo_espn,
    team,
    season,
    score,
    coach,
    offense,
    defense,
    team_color
  ) %>% 
  
  # Optional: top 10
  slice(1:32)

best_seasons_tbl <- best_seasons_tbl %>%
  mutate(team_color = ifelse(is.na(team_color), "black", team_color))

# -------------------------------
# Build GT table
# -------------------------------
gt_tbl <- best_seasons_tbl %>% 
  gt() %>% 
  
  # Render logos

    coach = "Head Coach",
    offense = "OC",
    defense = "DC"
  )

# -------------------------------

}

  cols_hide(columns = c(team_color)) %>%

    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = coach)
  )

gt_tbl
```

```{r}
fired <- c("TEN", "NYG", "ATL", "CLE", "LV", "BUF", "ARI", "BAL", "MIA")
cur_coaches <- coaches %>% 
  filter(Year == 2025) %>% 
  filter(!team%in%fired) %>% 
  pull(Coach)

best_available <- best_coaches %>% 
  filter(!coach_name%in%cur_coaches) %>% 
  mutate(score = total_score/seasons)
```

```{r}
hc_ever <- coaches %>% distinct(Coach) %>% pull()
```

```{r}
best_avail_asst <- best_available %>% 
  filter(!coach_name%in%hc_ever) %>% 
  filter(seasons > 2)
```

```{r}
best_avail_former_hc <- best_available %>% 
  filter(coach_name%in%hc_ever) %>% 
  filter(seasons > 2)
```
